_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F14, the library puzzle: the talking book's riddle (water) gives the ledger's third page.

text.zh_TW: 一本會說話的書飄在半空：「吾乃知識之書！答對吾之謎題，便給你最後一頁。『越洗越髒的是什麼？』」
text.en: A talking book floats in the air. "I am the Book of Knowledge! Answer my riddle and the last page is yours. 'What gets dirtier the more you wash?'"

text.zh_TW: 書：「錯！」它啪地合上，又打開。「……吾心情好，再給你一次機會。」
text.en: The book: "Wrong!" It snaps shut, then opens again. "...I am in a good mood. One more try."

text.zh_TW: 書：「正確！」一張紙從書頁間飛出來，落在你手上：名冊的最後一頁。
text.en: The book: "Correct!" A sheet flies out from between its pages and lands in your hand: the ledger's last page.
